description: Additional UTF-8 base64 boundary cases for empty payloads and invalid decoded byte sequences.

cases.description: Encoding an empty string still prints an empty canonical base64 value.
Base64 that decodes to invalid UTF-8 bytes is normalized to invalid encoded content.
cases.expected_output:
error=operation_failed
message=The encoded data was not valid for encoding utf-8
